extracted.intended_audience: historians of science and mathematics; archival researchers; readers interested in John Pell and 17th-century correspondence
extracted.subtask_description: Transcription and presentation of 17th-century letters and appendix material related to Sir John Pell, Governor Winthrop, and contemporaries (Royal Society correspondence, travel/introduction letters, and local reports). Useful for archival study, historical research, and edition preparation.
